identifier.value: Veterinary Consultation and Multi-Speciality Vet Care

product.name: Veterinary Consultation and Multi-Speciality Vet Care
product.description: Provides health assessments, diagnostics, treatment plans, and follow-up care for pets through in-person consultations with veterinarians.

product.name: Pet Surgery Services
product.description: Performs various surgical procedures including spaying, neutering, tumor removal, fracture repair, and emergency surgeries for pets.

product.name: Pet Grooming Services
product.description: Offers grooming services including bathing, haircuts, nail clipping, ear cleaning, and medicated baths in dedicated, pet-friendly environments.

product.name: 24/7 Emergency and Critical Care
product.description: Provides round-the-clock emergency veterinary care including urgent diagnostics, surgeries, ICU monitoring, and blood transfusions for critical pet conditions.

product.name: Diagnostic Services
product.description: In-house diagnostic testing including blood tests, biochemistry, X-rays, ultrasounds, and endoscopy to support accurate pet health assessments.

product.name: Pet Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation
product.description: Provides physiotherapy treatments for pets to aid recovery from surgery, manage pain, and treat conditions like arthritis and paralysis.
